text:
maya: Heads-up — CI flagged a quality regression on the quant bringup for model redwood-v2-mini-quant. Metric `qa_exact_match` dropped 5.4% vs baseline. CI link: https://ci.redwood.ai/4782. First observed in eval-run 4782.
ci-bot: build #4782 failed: metric qa_exact_match decreased from 0.812 -> 0.758 (-5.4%). See https://ci.redwood.ai/4782/diff
sam: ugh. did we merge any eval harness/runtime changes yesterday? @liam @sophie
liam: I rolled a runtime change yesterday that toggles KV cache eviction on quant runs (PR #3291). deployed ~03:10 UTC. could be related.
sophie: I merged a small metrics normalization in eval-metrics (PR #3295) but that should've increased scores not drop them.
maya: can someone bisect commit range 657..HEAD against the failing eval? run both CPU and GPU configs.
liam: starting bisect job now. command:
```
./scripts/eval_bisect.sh --range 657..HEAD --model redwood-v2-mini-quant --metric qa_exact_match --runner-tag canary
```
liam: kicked bisect job bisect-20260310-1. linking results when available.
sam: also inspect runner logs for kernel fallback messages like "using fallback kernel q8/simple_attn" — saw that in a prior outage.
bench-bot: bisect job queued: https://bench.redwood.ai/bisect-20260310-1
liam: bisect narrowed it down: commit 669 (runtime: kv-eviction tweak) consistently shows ~4.9% drop locally.
maya: ok. is reverting that runtime change safe? it's risky but this blocks the quant rollout.
sophie: from eval POV revert is fine. canary tests pass and metrics return to baseline.
liam: opened PR #3299 to revert kv-eviction change and deployed canary.
ci-bot: deploy canary #3300 started; running eval suite.
bench-bot: canary eval completed: qa_exact_match 0.811 (baseline). delta +5.1% vs failing run.
maya: cool — proceed to roll revert to prod and pause the quant bringup. notify release and CS.
sam: filing incident INC-20260310 — regression traced to kv eviction change; tagging eng-runtime, eng-ml.
maya: follow-up: add a unit/regression test to prevent kv-eviction toggles from affecting qa_exact_match. assign INS-3292 to @liam. add telemetry for kernel fallbacks.
liam: will implement tests + telemetry this week.
maya: :thumbsup:
